translation:
<ins>Supplementing the Middle and Benefiting Qi Decoction (補中益氣湯)</ins>
Ginseng (人參, two qian), astragalus (黃耆, honey-fried, two qian), atractylodes (白朮, stir-fried, one and a half qian), dang gui (當歸, one and a half qian), cimicifuga (升麻, five fen), bupleurum (柴胡, five fen), tangerine peel (陳皮, eight fen), licorice (甘草, honey-fried, three fen)
With the guiding herbs ginger (薑) and jujube (棗), decoct in water and take. <ins>Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯)</ins>
Ginseng (人參), atractylodes (白朮), poria (茯苓, each two qian), licorice (甘草, honey-fried, one qian)
With the guiding herbs ginger and jujube, decoct in water and take. <ins>Four Substances Decoction (四物湯)</ins>
Dang gui (當歸, three qian), chuanxiong (川芎), white peony (白芍藥, two qian), cooked rehmannia (熟地黃, three qian)
Decoct in water and take.
